notes.title: Patch V 1.1.9.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The next update is ready, and this time we’ve addressed several bottlenecks highlighted by our community. Most notably, you can now expand your factory grounds regardless of the era. We’ve also implemented multiple quality-of-life improvements, including customizable notifications, semi-continuous production, and resource purchasing. Our focus remains on streamlining the game flow and enhancing your overall experience.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/65cc45f5219050bc6729e12355002d3613641640.png"]

It is now possible to reinvest your hard-earned cash directly into your Factory. You can expand your process lines or build additional admin offices without waiting for an Era change. Be cautious with your spending, though—these expansions are costly and can quickly push your maintenance expenses beyond your limits.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/3faab572062bbdc7c3a43e9e913cffa6458f7020.png"]

As previously promised, we’ve now implemented the option to set production to semi-automatic mode. Once an ordered batch of tanks is completed, production will automatically resume if there are enough resources and sufficient space in the warehouse.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/103a6d1aba4e5fca327ba49e278a78bcdcf1ed80.png"]

A similar feature has been added to the warehouse, allowing you to reorder resources from the selected market, provided you have the space and funds available.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/f18209e74452df2bd6bd4c7d9687a23841e179a2.png"]

In response to multiple requests, we’ve added the ability to customize in-game notifications. You can now choose which types of notifications to display and whether they should pause the game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/ef5ee563d98e96a84c35183db5ffa0dfed2183f3.png"]

As always, we’ve introduced several quality-of-life improvements requested by the community. These include a new sorting option for the contract screen, a simplified tank design selection list in Test Drive mode, and more.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/832ecfd0cd4045d323fbdfa25e79dafef858b08d.png"]
The Diplomacy Center


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522792/fc32aa719e9d26d791a1e839e1a9463bb417d2dc.png"]

Here, you can now do everything previously only on the world map and in a much more easily navigated manner. Lobby for contracts, open and close trade offices, inspect countries, check the reputation, and whether they have any admins, it is all here now. I am sure you will like it, because I definitely do.



With these updates, we hope your gameplay experience becomes even more enjoyable!

FunGI Team


--

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.8.4
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The next Hotfix is ready, and this time it includes much more than just a few bug fixes. To make the game experience more enjoyable for new players, we are introducing several new features aimed at making the learning curve less steep during the first playthroughs. However, experienced players can still choose to play in the old “ironman” style.



 Government grants are a new mechanic that has been added to the game. With this new feature, each time you approach bankruptcy, the government will step in and subsidize your company with a certain amount of money. The amount and number of subsidies are limited and depend on the selected difficulty level. Note that for any difficulty level, you can always choose the “Ironman” mode, effectively deactivating this “grant” mechanic if you want to play without any compromises or “second chances.”
https://i.postimg.cc/1RrnRBCV/Picture1.png
 Another new addition is a useful hint added to the tank role assistant. Now, when you select a tank role in the Assistance tool, your engineers will advise you on which tank hull they recommend as a base for your tank design. Note that there is usually more than one way to create a successful design for any given tank role, so make sure to experiment until you find your best design!
https://i.postimg.cc/50wHCSfG/Picture2.png
 Following the feedback, we have revised the compatibility of alloy and assembly type. From this moment on, you are no longer limited to using contemporary alloy and assembly modifications for your structural components. Moreover, we have revisited the UI, hopefully making it easier and more user-friendly.
https://i.postimg.cc/Wz8h9pFw/Picture3.png
 We also added multiple QoL changes that were requested or voted on by the community. These include new sorting options for the Contract Centre, the possibility to archive rival designs in Reverse Engineering, limiting tank fame to avoid fame exploits in contracts, and others
https://i.postimg.cc/tJpstnTg/Picture4.png
 Finally, we are very happy to add another language to the game. Now the game can be experienced in simplified Chinese as well!
https://i.postimg.cc/yY6JDRtQ/Picture5.png


Thank you for your continued support!
FunGI Team

notes.title: WW2 Content Update released
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

We are very excited to share with you the WW2 Era  Update!

With a new World War approaching, the tank engineers are rushing to perfect their design and prepare them for the challenges that are approaching. Follow their tracks or design your own tank combining the technologies of the Interwar and WW2 era!

Starting Monday March 31st 10:00 AM PST / 1PM EST the game will also have a Daily Deal with a 25% discount! It's the perfect time to jump in and experience the game at it's finest!

Update Summary:

 12 new vehicles added including British, German, Russian and American tanks. It is important to note that we will continue to add WW2 tanks to the game as we continue the development
https://i.postimg.cc/0NFX76LS/Picture1.png

A total of 170+ research nodes introducing new components, modifications, and expendables
https://i.postimg.cc/5yqPcsj5/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201625.png

The possibility to combine and mix components from the Interwar and WW2 periods
https://i.postimg.cc/DwzxDdhs/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202817.png

Tank role roster expanded with 12 new roles to account for WW2 vehicles 
https://i.postimg.cc/xTnxGVF6/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202311.png

Expanded factory ground functionality with new facilities, new administrator characters and additional process lines to pipeline your activities 
https://i.postimg.cc/ydRQj1Hb/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201326.png

Several important QoL improvements including Part compatibility assistant, component and part archiving and Design assistant in Engineering bureau and others
https://i.postimg.cc/9FbxJg6C/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-202434.png

Extended possibility to select the Start era of your game into WW2 period
https://i.postimg.cc/zv1dPsDX/Sk-rmbild-2025-03-26-201737.png

Game localization to 5 languages including German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Polish


The new era brings a rebalance to certain aspects of the game. We believe that these adjustments will enhance the overall experience, making it more enjoyable and immersive. Additionally, we have dedicated significant time to implementing crucial quality-of-life improvements based on your continuous feedback on Steam and our Discord channel.

However, please note that due to the extensive nature of these changes, your saved game files will not be compatible with version 1.1.8.0. Although we made every effort to ensure compatibility, the sheer magnitude of the alterations proved to be too substantial. To compensate for that, you can also select the Era 3 for a start-up!
Thank you for your continued understanding and patience!

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.7.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

The 1.1.7.0 Update is ready, and we are excited to release it to you!

As before, the patch introduces new content, several important changes to the game, and several fixes based on your feedback from Steam and Discord.

https://i.postimg.cc/RFfrrFZ9/Bild1.png

We continue to expand the world map. This time, it grew eastward to include Russia, China, and Japan. In addition to providing new battlegrounds and markets for your tanks, Russia introduces two new tanks from the Interwar Era: the T18 and T28 tanks. Inspired by the legendary Renault and Vickers designs, these tanks offer you even more options for experimentation and customization.

https://i.postimg.cc/Pq0GFZh2/Bild2.png

Additional efforts have been made to revisit country logic. Now, countries will be more eager to modernize their tank fleets with newer designs, raising their expectations for the tanks they are willing to purchase.

https://i.postimg.cc/P53nY97G/Bild3.png

Significant changes have been made to the Tank Contract system. We have now introduced a Trade Office mechanic, which serves as a trade representation for your company. You must set up a Trade Office in every country where you wish to engage in tank trade. Establishing a Trade Office incurs costs, so careful planning is essential to determine where to expand your company.

https://i.postimg.cc/JhsVqKws/Bild4.png

Resource holdings are now part of the game. These holdings provide a stable income of a specific resource in exchange for a significant investment. As a player, you can choose to rely on external resource suppliers or reinvest your capital into resource holdings.

https://i.postimg.cc/0jqT9szS/Bild5.png

The Legal Centre is another addition to the game. Your lawyers are prepared to negotiate favorable conditions for tank contracts and labor unions, provided you have sufficient funds to pay for their services.

https://i.postimg.cc/qBsfjzFx/Bild6.png

Finally, we have introduced War mechanics. With this mechanics in place, wars will span multiple military campaigns, with the possibility of allies joining the conflict. Countries will assemble even larger task forces to wage war, resulting in more intense fighting and, consequently, more frequent resupply contracts.

https://i.postimg.cc/3NCPRcGc/Bild7.png

This patch also includes a significant amount of QoL changes, bug fixes, balancing adjustments, and text corrections. Don’t forget to check the complete patch details below or view the update notes directly in the game.

https://i.postimg.cc/MKqC4z22/Bild8.png

As we move forward along the roadmap, the WW2 Era update is beginning to take shape. Development is steady and in line with our plans.

We hope you enjoy this update, and as always, please don’t forget to share your thoughts and feedback with us!

FunGI Team

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.6.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

We’re excited to present our holiday gift: the 1.1.6.0 Patch is now available!

This patch introduces new content, several important changes to the game, and numerous fixes based on your feedback from Steam and Discord.

https://i.postimg.cc/mrSWTsKD/USA.png

North America is now unlocked, with the USA leading the charge. In addition to providing a new market for your tanks, the United States introduced two new tanks from the Interwar Era: the T1 Cunningham and the M1921. Get your hands on these new tanks and experiment with combinations by mixing them with British, German, and French models.

https://i.postimg.cc/RhhBPDs0/T1-Cunnighma.png

Additional efforts have been directed toward quality of life improvements. To reduce clutter, filter settings now allow multiple choices, enabling you to fine-tune them to your preferences in all scenes.

https://i.postimg.cc/GpPd9YTb/Filters.png

We have also revisited various tooltips and UI elements in the Design, Engineering, and Contract scenes to make number management more transparent.

https://i.postimg.cc/L8LM0fTj/UI-design.png

Staff management has also been enhanced. You can now hire or fire employees from anywhere in the game, eliminating the need to visit the Administration each time.

https://i.postimg.cc/JnP85LQg/HR.png

Design defects have also been revisited. They are now explained in greater detail, clearly distinguishing between crew-related issues and design limitations. Furthermore, addressing defects no longer requires travel to the Proving Grounds; you can now handle amendments directly, albeit at a higher cost. Note, Proving Grounds is temporarily disabled until new game mechanics are in place!

https://i.postimg.cc/nzHZmzqB/M1921.png

We also did a good portion of bug hunting, balancing, and text corrections. Don’t forget to check at the complete Patch details below or check the update note directly from the game.

We continue to work further along the Road Map. In the next update, you can expect some new exciting features to be added and even more countries to enter the tank race, enriching the Interwar tank portfolio even further. We are also steadily progressing towards the WW2 Era update, expect more news on that very soon!  

Happy New Year to All!


FunGI Team

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.5.0

Greetings, Arms Dealers!


1.1.5.0 Patch is now available for you!

https://i.postimg.cc/y8VLQMvP/Design-Assist.png

The team is committed to delivering the next content update promptly. You can look forward to more countries joining the tank race, each adding new Interwar tanks to the game. Finally, we are actively developing content for the World War II era.

Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey with us.

FunGI Team

notes.title: Dev. Update: October
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers! 

With the Interbellum expansion released, the team is already hard at work on upcoming updates! In this dev blog, we’re excited to share what awaits us on our journey to the next major milestone: the WWII expansion. 


https://i.postimg.cc/CKCFXMgF/EA-Roadmap-2-2.png

 Game Tutorial
     
Arms Trade Tycoon is a complex and unique game that requires time and effort to fully grasp its mechanics and enjoy the experience. To support all new players, we are thrilled to introduce a comprehensive tutorial to guide you through the key steps to becoming a successful Arms Trade Tycoon! This immersive tutorial is built around a specific WWI tank, making your learning experience even more engaging. Plus, upon completion, the tutorial will reward you with several bonuses that will carry over into the game!     

 Design Assistant

With over 20 different tank roles already in the game—and even more on the way—designing components or whole tanks to fit each role can be a daunting challenge. To make your job as a designer easier, we’re excited to introduce the Engineer Assistant! This helpful tool will guide you in selecting the right role and ensure that your designs are a perfect match!

 Espionage centre 

Reverse engineering is one of the core mechanics that allows you to combine tank parts from different countries and eras. To reduce reliance on the randomness of trophies, we’re thrilled to introduce the Espionage Centre! Here, you'll be able to strategize your next industrial espionage moves and gain the upper hand over your rivals!     

 USA joins the game

The time has come to expand the world and unlock new territories across the Atlantic! Many new countries will join the race for the ultimate tank, with the USA leading the charge. Get ready for additional tanks in the Interwar Era, inspired by the American tank school!


 World in flames 

With this feature implemented, countries can engage in global wars that engulf multiple territories and continents, stretching over months and even years. It’s the perfect environment to grow a successful Arms Tycoon!


 Compatibility Assistant 

To streamline your planning for the ultimate tank design, we will introduce a tank component compatibility tool! This feature will allow you to plan already from the Research Bureau stage, helping you determine which tank components to focus on for maximum effectiveness!

 Holdings for purchase 

This feature empowers players to invest their hard-earned capital and acquire a variety of assets from countries with high reputation ratings! The effects of these assets will vary, but each one will be a fantastic addition to your growing arms trade empire!

 Russia joins the game 

The world expands once again, this time to the east! New countries are set to join the race for the ultimate tank, with Russia leading the charge. Get ready for additional tanks in the Interwar Era, inspired by the rich legacy of the Russian tank school!

 Diplomacy centre

With numerous potential countries now open for trade, it’s crucial to streamline the information available about each prospective customer. This feature will consolidate all that data into a single window, allowing you to effortlessly access vital details about every potential buyer for your tanks!

 Decals and Camo

This feature is fully dedicated to enhancing tank design mechanics! With its implementation, you'll be able to make your tanks truly unique by utilizing a variety of decals and an expanded portfolio of camouflage options!

 Localizations 
   
This addition has been highly requested on our Steam forums and Discord server! With the WWII update on the horizon, it's the perfect time to expand language support and enhance the gaming experience for those who prefer to play in languages other than English

 Free WW2 expansion pack

This is the next major free update for the game that will introduce a lot of new content – the World War 2 Era! Gameplay time will be again extended, many new tanks will join the game, including some of the most iconic WWII models.


https://i.postimg.cc/6QxWM2Fj/Little-Willie.png

We plan is to roll out these features across several updates, with WWII being the next major content expansion pack! Please note that the order of these features may change as we progress toward the WWII era.

Once again, we wanted to thank you all for your support and feedback. Stay tuned for our upcoming development blogs!



FunGI Team

notes.title: Dev. Update: August
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers! 

In anticipation of the release of the Interbellum update we have kept mostly quiet working diligently to make it the best it can be, and we wanted to thank you for your patience. We are ready to show more of the future update that will soon hit the experimental build! 

https://i.postimg.cc/x1sKv7CV/PIC1.png

As mentioned, we’ve been working as hard as ever on the update and wanted to showcase our progress. Here you can see many new parts unique to the update that was made to fit and be as cross-compatible as possible, including but not limited to the Vickers No. 1, Independent Landship, and Char B1 tanks

https://i.postimg.cc/Lsb3p7K3/PIC2.png

In addition, for experienced players who already know the game well, we will add the ability to start directly in the new era, in 1921. This is not recommended for first-time players due to the increase in complexity and difficulty.

https://i.postimg.cc/90GdyQ4L/PIC3.png

On top of new tanks and parts, the update also brings:

 New administrators, each with their own bonuses.
 New facility upgrades as well as a new look to bring them into the new era
 Additional process lines to existing buildings 
 Multiple revisions to building upgrades and maintenance costs


https://i.postimg.cc/Gt0PBypB/PIC4.png

https://i.postimg.cc/vHsLbfjk/PIC5.png

As always, you can customize all your tank components as you see fit. Using parts from both eras you can create the best or weirdest weapons of war the world has ever seen.

https://i.postimg.cc/c4B7H6GH/PIC6.png

A new era also means new challenges! As the new chapter of history opens for countries of the world, they will update their military forces and change their doctrines accordingly. New tank roles to fill and opponents to confront are sure to arise to make use of modern tank technologies.

https://i.postimg.cc/HLVbB2cc/PIC7.png

Apart from the new content we’ve also worked on various quality-of-life features that were demanded by player feedback, such as:

 Filters and sorting options for a variety of screens
 Fast travel buttons
 Flexible bank loans
 New tank series display and options
 Improved modification classifications and naming


https://i.postimg.cc/T1qbpNSS/PIC8.png

We plan to start monthly development blogs to better keep you all up to date with the state of future updates. We want to get the Interbellum update into experimental testing within next weeks, and afterward continue onto other content updates.

FunGI Team

notes.title: Patch V 1.1.3.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Arms Dealers!

1.1.3.0 Patch is finally available for you!

This patch introduces a lot of changes to the game with the focus on tank contracts and relation building with the customer countries. The tank design process has also been revisited, allowing players to tweak the armour protection of structural components and making tank “cloning” a more playable option.

More efforts have also been spent on the QoL side, with the most prominent ones being the possibility to advance time from anywhere in the game, addition of various filters and sorting options and enriching multiple tooltips with useful info. Components have been the subject of a major overhaul, resulting in more variation between individual modifications.

As always, we also did a good portion of bug hunting and corrections. Please, have a look at the complete Patch details below or check the update note directly from the game.

Last but not least, the next update (1.1.4.0) will finally introduce something that many have been requesting - a totally new content, the Interbellum tanks. https://i.postimg.cc/43n3pSS3/Vickers1-Mark8.png

The team is working diligently to bring you the next update as soon as possible. However, in order to ensure a polished and high-quality release, we must shift the timeline slightly. You can expect the update to be available in the near future.

notes.title: Dev Update: April
notes.content:
Greetings!

Time for our monthly Update. 
Today we want to share with you some of the progress that has been done since last time. Some of the improvements and changes you can already find in Development Build or that will be added very soon.

Factory Grounds:

 We continue to work on the Facilities. Each Facility and its upgrade are getting a unique look that reflects its purpose. Some of the Facilities will affect all Buildings while others will offer unique bonuses to certain Buildings. 

https://i.postimg.cc/9QSCjgXj/Power-Units-1.jpg

 Arms Trade Tycoon Tanks is a game about tanks, but the Tycoon part requires other types of vehicles to be present in the game. Vehicles that you won’t design or sell, but you will see them in your Factory Grounds, standing still near the buildings or moving along the roads. It is these details or “props”, that make the game experience more immersive, atmospheric and engage the players in new ways. Today, we want to show you some new Truck models  that you will find when playing for Britain.

https://i.postimg.cc/rwzM32kJ/Trucks-Screenshots-01.jpg

  Without a doubt, the Production Hall will determine the prosperity of your Tycoon Empire. Here you will mass produce your tanks and ensure that you have the appropriate Workshops for the intricacy of your tanks design. 
We believe that, given its significance, this building merits special attention. Many references were studied, and a lot of work was put into the "props" to give the interior scene a realistic look. Finally, the lighting was completely redone to make the scene both atmospheric and immersive.

https://i.postimg.cc/tJ27dd3C/Production-1.png


 Engineering Workshop:

 Already in the next Dev. Build you will be able to experience a “first shot” at the Reverse-Engineering.
We have talked about it for some time and now you’ll finally able to dismantle some German tanks and use their parts to construct your own curse patterns! 
For the time being you’ll be able to tinker with Sturmpanzerwagen  A7V and LK2 but this is just the beginning, more to come soon!

https://i.postimg.cc/j2srhGcy/Reverse-Engineering-Screenshots-01.png

 We continue to add new tank component to the game. Already with the next update to the Development Build, you will be able to employ a predecessor for QF 6 pounder Hotchkiss gun!
Light but deadly – the QF 6 pounder Nordenfelt gun is a welcomed addition to your arsenal.

Note that this gun should not be confused with the short-barreled 57 mm Cockerill-Nordenfelt which was employed to arm the German A7V tank and which will be added to the game! 

https://i.postimg.cc/m2Lb3FpK/QF-6-Pounder-Nordenfelt-1-1.jpg

 We should also want to highlight two new features already accessible in the Dev. Build! Namely, various assembly" and armour plating types" available for you tanks. 

During the engineering process you can chose what assembly process suits your needs best for any Hull or Turret component. This is a compromise that you must make between production costs and attributes for your tanks. Would you select riveted assembly to speed up your production but sacrifice crew safety or go for welded components? The choice is yours!

Currently, you can select bolted and riveted assemblies, but welding and casting are also in the pipeline.

In a similar way, you can select between various armour alloys. Here the compromise is between production costs and what type of protection you need for your vehicle. Should your tank have a better chance against AP rounds or is HESH rounds that you need to be afraid off? Make sure to consider what enemies your tanks might face on the battlefield! The outcome of the entire military campaign may depend on your choice! 

https://i.postimg.cc/L6xmx6r5/Bolts.jpg


Hope you liked the update!

Don't forget to wishlist the game and join our Discord channel for weekly updates:
[url=]discord.com/invite/cHdwDzd 

FunGI Team
